text: Three weeks later, the answer is in a thread, a note, or memory.
Six cartons of tomato paste. Quoted at eighteen thousand naira, agreed at seventeen and a half.
Ask it what was agreed, and what went wrong.
It answers with seven sources, each one a real event in the record.
Four of six cartons arrived. Two were missing. The supplier credited three and a half thousand.
Every sentence names the event it came from.
